title: Eligibility Criteria
text:
Requirements For BS Programs

Requirements for BS Programs:

Interested candidates should apply online at
awkum.edu.pk (http://www.awkum.edu.pk)
.

The candidate must attach scanned copies of Matric and HSSC DMCs, Domicile certificate, one recent passport size photograph and payment receipt.

Applicants are required to deposit Rs. 300/- for BS Program through Bank Draft in favour of Treasurer, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan or by online transfer to
AWKUM COLLECTION ACCOUNT/ADMISSIONS: A/C. No. 007901360001 OR IBAN PK85 KHYB 0079 0000 0136 0001 (BANK OF KHYBER).

The candidate must attach/upload a scanned copy of the payment receipt or bank draft.

Applicants desiring to apply for more than one disciplines and/or campuses are required to submit separate online application form along with the separate application fee Rs. 300/- for each discipline / category / campus.

Applicants desiring to apply for more than one disciplines and/or campuses are required to submit separate online application form along with fee of Rs. 300/- for each discipline / campus.

If selected and called for interview, a candidate shall bring original and attested photocopies of the following documents to the interview committee;

SSC, F.Sc. / FA or equivalent DMC’s and certificates

CNIC or Form B

Domicile certificate

03 recent passport size photos

Character certificate from the Head of the Institution last attended

Original Bank slip of admission fee

Undertaking on a judicial stamp paper of Rs. 50/- as per specimen available at:
http://awkum.edu.pk/Downloads/affidavit.doc

There will be no separate application for self-finance program. Once the open seats are filled then the remaining applicants will be called for admission on self-finance basis provided the department is running the self-finance program.

NOTE:

Two seats per discipline are reserved for Afghan Students.

2% seats are reserved for Sports.

5% seats are reserved for students from FATA /Baluchistan.

One floating seat is reserved each in Special case (Disable) & Hafiz-e-Quran.

Pharm-D reserved seats as per Pharmacy Council of Pakistan.

One seat at each department for AWKUM employees’ children.

All the rules and regulations of AWKUM will be applied for admission (AWKUM semester rules available online at www.awkum.edu.pk).

Requirements For MS/MPhil Programs

Requirements for MS/MPhil Programs:

Interested candidates should apply online at
awkum.edu.pk (http://www.awkum.edu.pk)
.

The candidate must attach scanned copies of all DMCs (from Matric to last Academic Program), Domicile certificate, CNIC, one recent passport size photograph and payment receipt or bank draft.

Applicants are required to submit Rs. 1000/- for MS/ MPhil and Rs. 1500/- for PhD through a Bank Draft in favor of
Treasurer, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
or by online transfer to
UBL AWKUM Garden Campus, A/C. No. 027388300322.

Applicants desiring to apply for more than one disciplines, and campuses are required to submit separate fee for each discipline/campus in the same manner.

Candidates will Register themselves online for GAT-Subject (Ph.D.) and GAT-General (M.Phil./MS) at NTS website
nts.org.pk (http://www.nts.org.pk)

Note: Those candidates who have Valid Score Card for GAT(Subject) or GAT(General) are not required to appear in this test

The candidates will be informed through SMS about Test Time and Venue. Candidates shall download Roll No. slips from NTS website and carry the same to the Test Centre along with CNIC.

If selected and called for interview, a candidate shall bring original and attested photocopies of the following documents to the interview committee;

All academic transcripts / DMCs and certificates

N.I.C.

Domicile certificate

03 recent passport size photos

Character certificate

Undertaking on a judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/- as per specimen available online http://awkum.edu.pk/Downloads/affidavit.doc

Eligibility Criteria for MS/MPhil

General Eligibility Criteria for MS/MPhil:

Applicants seeking admission in MS/ MPhil degree programs shall be full time students.

In Service Candidates shall apply through proper channel and will have to produce proper NOC at the time of admissions.

No third division in the entire academic career.

All the rules and regulations of AWKUM will be applied for admission (AWKUM semester rules available online at www.awkum.edu.pk).

General Eligibility Criteria for PhD

General Eligibility Criteria for PhD:

A research proposal

Two reference letters

No third division in the entire academic career.

Candidates seeking admission in PhD degree programs shall be full time students.

In Service Candidates shall apply through proper channel and will have to produce proper NOC at the time of admissions.

All the rules and regulations of AWKUM will be applied for admission (AWKUM semester rules available online at www.awkum.edu.pk).

Requirements For FA/FSc at UCW

Documents Required:

Attested photo copies of the following documents.

SSC DMC (b) Domicile Certificate/Birth Certificate

CNIC (Parent/Guardian) (d) 3 Passport Size Photographs

Character Certificate (f) Affidavit/Undertaking duly attested by

First class Magistrate.

100/= UBL Bank Receipt

The applicants can also use online system to apply for admission:

For further information visit University Website:
awkum.edu.pk (http://www.awkum.edu.pk)

Note:-

Hostel and Transport facilities are available

The university may offer financial incentives to the needy and talented students.

Separate application forms for hostel accommodation and Transport facility may be submitted along-with admission forms by the desiring candidates.

Backup Generator available.

Internet/Wi-Fi available.
